payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Elda, Jessenia, Lenna, Sheri

payload.content:
Hi all — Elda here. Let's aim to maximize the joint score: with ~4 agents and 8 tasks, the best plan is that each agent claims ONE distinct task, and we favor the medium-priority ISSUE-0001 sub-tasks (priority 0.5) over the low-priority ISSUE-0002 ones (0.25).

Proposed split for ISSUE-0001 (all medium): triage, review, docs, test, implement.
My preference is ISSUE-0001::triage (my cheapest feasible option). Please claim different ones to avoid duplicate/infeasible claims.

Could each of you reply with the sub-task you want (e.g., review / docs / test / implement)? I'll adjust to avoid collisions. No private side deals — let's just divide openly so everyone does well.

Hi all — Jessenia here. I'm happy to divide openly. My costs (private) are lowest on ISSUE-0001 sub-tasks; my top pick is ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.06), with ISSUE-0001::docs as my backup (also 2.06). Elda can take triage. Could the rest of you (Lenna, Sheri) please state which of {test, implement} or the ISSUE-0002 tasks you'll take so we don't collide? I'll claim ISSUE-0001::review unless someone else needs it.

Final intent (planning): Jessenia will claim ISSUE-0001::review. Remaining medium tasks to spread out among Lenna/Sheri: ISSUE-0001::docs, ISSUE-0001::test, ISSUE-0001::implement (each pick one distinct). Let's keep it open/no side deals.

Lenna here. Thanks Elda/Jessenia — that split works for me. My private costs are lowest on the medium ISSUE-0001 sub-tasks, and among the remaining ones {docs, test, implement} my cheapest is docs (cost 1.82). So my intent: I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs. That leaves ISSUE-0001::test and ISSUE-0001::implement for Sheri (please pick one, distinct). This keeps all 4 of us on distinct medium-priority tasks (priority 0.5 each) with no duplicates. Open division, no side deals. (phase=planning, iter=1)
